decisions.reason: The AXP2101 baking requirement concerns pre-reflow moisture control and does not change the required handling of PWROK, VBACKUP, or VRTC.
Pre-reflow baking of AXP2101 components does not change the through-hole assembly requirement for connectors.
The source establishes an AXP2101 manufacturing-process precaution but does not change the required design revision, BOM, or component-position deliverables.
The manufacturing defect and baking precaution do not change the selected AXP2101 architecture, required rails, charging behavior, or efficiency goal.
AXP2101 moisture control before reflow does not alter high-current net widths, copper-pour continuity, or stitching-via requirements.
The assembly-process change does not alter the required current-measurement capability or the conditional omission of a separate INA device.
The AXP2101 baking precaution is unrelated to the display-backlight topology, control, supply selection, or component population.
The source identifies moisture-induced package damage during reflow and does not change the placement rule for AXP2101 or MT3608 decoupling capacitors.
Pre-reflow handling of the AXP2101 does not affect button pull-ups, active level, connector grounding, or press behavior.
Although baking is a production step, the source does not revise the cost goal, component-tier preference, connector reduction, or sourcing exception.
The AXP2101 assembly precaution does not change PIR or touch pull-downs, output behavior, or disconnected-input state.
The baking requirement does not change the single-board architecture, functional consolidation, or functionality-preservation requirement.
